description:
Hi Translate (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.zaz.translate)
Bloated translation app with a lot of trackers and permissions (https://reports.exodus-privacy.eu.org/fr/reports/com.zaz.translate/latest/)
It has the Camera and microphone permissions and use the Google Translate API for the translations.
Pithus analysis: https://beta.pithus.org/report/fdd787d96c3e069f983320c84c32fc6b8cdf205df17244d190b181edf0c14f68
